definitions.explanation: The number fourteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {四|よん} (four). Note that よん is used instead of し to avoid the homophone with {死|し} (death).

notes:
{十四|じゅうよん} is the number fourteen, formed by combining ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ (ten) and ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧ (four).

PRONUNCIATION:
よん is preferred over し because し sounds like ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death). However, じゅうし is occasionally used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十四|じゅうよん}⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧: fourteen years old
- {十四|じゅうよん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: fourteen people
- {十四|じゅうよん}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: 2 PM (14:00 in 24-hour time)

SPECIAL DATE READING:
For the 14th day of the month, use ⟦{十四日|じゅうよっか}→十四日：30216_juuyokka⟧ (not じゅうよんにち).
